title: Entities based on the Moon airdropping tech to Earth

tellings.quote: So, so in what in your mind, what have they been doing? They've been airdropping tech here and there and

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, floats an idea while talking with a guest: that some beings based on the Moon have been "airdropping tech here and there" on Earth. He puts it as a question about what they have been doing, with no time or place given. If true, it would mean some human technology was handed to us from outside.
